'''master-jedi Let's Free Han with a twist''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[master-jedi]]
* '''Published:''' 29 September 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Profit master-jedi LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a basic Profit deck with a twist.  It is aimed at going to the chamber and simple out power you opponet.  The key to this deck is You’ve got a lot of guts coming here.  Rebel’s Ability = 3 are power & forfiet + 2 at Jabba’s Site.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

This whole deck revolves around your draw.  Get out your sites with MOTF.  If you have a Jedi, get them down and free Han.  If not and have a Narrow Escape, deploy and only stay in the battle if you have the advantage.  The secret weapon in this deck is Lando.  He is power 8 fofiet 9 and if he target’s with his weapon, subracts 2 from characters power.  Use Wokling to get Lighsaber Prof. on a jedi to increase power.  Here is a list of the power of character’s

Luke, Jedi Knight 8 w/ saber

Lando 8 & -2 to opponent w gun

Han (V) 6 & +3 weapon destiny w/ his gun

Chewie 9 enough said

Owen & Beru 6 for only 3 deploy

Now some tech –

Ben Kenobi + Lightsaber + Proficiency + Cape + Journal = Nice or

Qui-Gon Jinn + Lightsaber + Proficiency = 9 power, immunity to attrition, power -1 to aliens, and helps w/ duels

Luke + Owen & Beru = Opponent not battling unless they want power 14 Luke and Owen & Beru coming back with bacta tank.

Lando and Chewie @ Tosche Station = Power 17, 2 battle destinies & +8 force generation.

Match-ups

Invasion – Should be an easy win since it is so card intensive and slow.  Free Han 1st turn and get the damage going.  I would not battle because of Droid Racks.  Make them lose from drains and Objective damage.

Big Blue Space –  Depends if they set up fast and get FWKTIL going.  If they have no aliens you are in good shape.  Get your ships in the air and disrupt the drains.  A good match

Dark Side Combat – Very hard match up.  If the have good aliens and you don’t get jedi early, you could be in trouble.  This is where Lando can shine.

Hunt Down – If you can kill Vader you win.  If he gets Vader and Maul out, you will be in a fight.  You must be aggressive keep Vader off the table.

Any suggestions would be nice thanks…..
